name: How long does deck repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does deck repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck repair depends on the scope and complexity of the project. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few boards or securing loose railings, might only take a day or two. More extensive repairs involving structural elements, multiple sections, or significant wood replacement could take several days to a week or more. Weather conditions can also influence the timeline, especially for tasks involving drying times for stains or sealants. Frasheski Construction can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing your specific deck repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs can take a day or two, while extensive repairs might take several days to over a week, depending on the scope.
